storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Faint is a faded, hard-to-hatch seed.

People pity her for her flaws and love her for her weaknesses.

Yet those who knew she had chosen to remain in the shell, had long since turned to dust—stardust.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
In June of A.F. 282, acting upon an investigation request submitted by the Mystea Treaty Committee, we dispatched a survey team to the New Leonia region.

Since the meteorite impact a year ago, the area has experienced an abnormally elevated mortality rate.

Furthermore, investigators discovered several species of mutated flora at the impact site. Instrumental analysis confirmed that these plants contain high levels of radiation, suspected to have been introduced by the meteorite.

However, no extraterrestrial minerals were found within the impact crater. According to villager testimony, on the third day after the impact, a group of scientists in white coats dissected and removed the meteorite in its entirety.

(Note: Suspected to be a non-governmental scientific organization; identity remains unverified.)

Following coordination between the Committee and local authorities, all residents have been evacuated, and the area has been officially declared a prohibited living zone.

According to calculations by the Mythag University Physics Laboratory, this residential ban must remain in effect for at least 80 years.

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Faint saw the student secretly weeping in the laboratory.

She wasn't Faint's favorite student, but she was undoubtedly the one who liked her the most.

The girl never minded Faint's resistance and aloofness, nor was she afraid of Faint's uncontrollable abilities.

She would spend her entire allowance on sweets, just because she was worried that Faint didn't have enough energy; she would wear the clunky protective suit just to comb Faint's tangled hair.

... <Italic:I must repay her>, Faint thought.

So, Faint did what she could.

—<Italic:If she was just worried about failing exams, then I'll just threaten the others into failing instead, right?>

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Among these sisters, one of them should never have been born.

On the Desolate of the Lyra constellation, Faint and Tinct spent half their lives shrouded in malice.

But who is the unacknowledged one?

Sister Faint is powerful yet uncontrollable; the life force she plunders seems to flow away like a river, leaving her to barely survive by licking the remaining dewdrops.

Sister Tinct is beautiful yet struggles to be independent; her life is as stubborn as duckweed, yet rooted nowhere, causing her to revolve around her sister.

Perhaps they both believe they are the one who should not exist. It's just that Faint made her decision earlier—using her own life as a threat, she forced her sister onto the journey of departure.

"Leave, Tinct. Don't let me hold you back."

"You shall sing among the stars, becoming the most dazzling color."

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Do I deserve to have wishes?

If I do, can I become a part of my sister?

To make her whole, to make us whole.

Only then could I express "love" without reservation, and she could embrace "love" with an undivided heart.

Dear Tinct... perhaps this is what I, as the firstborn child, should do for you...

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: Please, please don't come any closer. It's dangerous... for you.

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: Th-thank you for the meal...

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: Have you grown a little?

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: Sorry, it's hard for me to grow my body...

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: Can I really eat all of this?

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: I'll do my best to grow up.

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: Maybe when I grow up, I'll be able to control myself and not drain others' Life... Just a tiny bit is enough for me to survive.

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: Seems like I've gotten heavier. Can the cradle still bear my weight?

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: I've eaten up so much power, it's about to overflow. My back is itching, too. Am I... growing up?

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: Although I still look like a child... Now I have the power to protect you.

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: Sorry, I'm not like the others... I'm a flawed product.

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: The cradle is cramped, with no room to stretch my body... But Tinct said that, for everyone's safety, I should remain in the cradle... Since this is her wish, I will comply.

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: Tinct is my twin sister. Unlike me, she always shines brightly... Without my drag, she would have a brighter future, her singing echoing throughout the galaxy...

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: If I stay here, don't I need to pay anything? I can help you gain status here. Just threaten to drain their lives—it's simple, like what I did for Tinct... Ah! Don't tell anyone about this!

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: I never thought anyone other than Tinct would accept me. I'm glad to have met you, Keeper. I will do my best to learn how to control my power, so that when I hug you, I won't drain your life force... A hug, right? The human way of expressing gratitude?

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: Umm... I can't control my ability to absorb life force, so please don't put your hand in the cradle, or you'll get sick.

daily.title: Chat: About Winkle
daily.content: Miss Winkle, like me, isn't from this planet... There's nothing tying me to my home except Tinct. I wonder how Miss Winkle feels about her homeland?

daily.title: Chat: About Tinct
daily.content: During my days of drifting among the stars, I dreamed of this moment countless times... Thank you for reuniting me with Tinct.

daily.title: Chat: About Aurita
daily.content: I've been too shy to tell Aurita that I'm not as young as she thinks. I'm not her "little sister." Could you perhaps help me mention that to her?

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: If our home hadn't experienced Dissolution, Tinct and I wouldn't be apart... I hate Dissolution more than I hate vegetables.

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: Sorry, I can't leave the cradle... It might block everyone's view, so I'll stay at the back of the classroom.

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: Things I like? I like Tinct's lullabies... Of course, your singing is wonderful too!

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: Can I skip the vegetables? Though Tinct said not to be picky, I don't like their colors...

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: Tinct said, "Repay kindness." So, as long as it is within my ability to help, I will lend a hand...

battle.title: Investigation Begins
battle.content: Like how I protected Tinct, I'll protect you, too.

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: ...Hic. Ah, sorry, I ate up too much energy again.

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: If the situation calls for it, I can leave the cradle, too...

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: A world... where no one will be harmed... will come.

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: I am still... the Color out of Space!
